_fixture: FIXTURE data for tests and screenshots only. Shapes of strategy_360, par_matrix, tech_stack, niche_candidates and social_intelligence v2. Not real observations.

executiveSummary: FIXTURE. Marketplaces win on price and next-day delivery; we cannot out-Amazon Amazon, so the own site should win on gifting, discovery by age and the store network.
Specialty players turn stores into the reason to buy online: pickup, stock check and events. These are the biggest par gaps to confirm.
Don Quijote is a channel: the planned shop-in-shop should be fed by LINE and the app, not treated as a rival.

positioningByTier.howTheyWin: Assortment depth, next-day delivery and points stacking.
positioningByTier.implication: Do not compete on price alone; compete on curation and gifting.

positioningByTier.howTheyWin: Store network plus WAON points and store pickup.
positioningByTier.implication: Match pickup and stock check before adding new features.

positioningByTier.howTheyWin: Age-based navigation and value for young families.
positioningByTier.implication: Build an age and occasion finder.

positioningByTier.howTheyWin: Exclusives and drops that sell out.

standOut.move: Gift concierge with wrapping and noshi
standOut.whyMarketplacesCannot: Third-party sellers cannot guarantee wrapping or presentation.

moves: QR to app download at the shelf

onlineToStore.tactic: Reserve online, pick up in store
onlineToStore.howItWorks: Hold stock for 3 days at the chosen store.
Book a play session from the site and LINE.

partnerPlay.summary: Use the Don Quijote shop-in-shop as a discovery point for the app and LINE.
risks: Price perception next to discount aisles

techLandscape.summary: Most specialty players run a hosted platform with Japanese site search and local payments.

parGaps.action: Confirm whether pickup exists; if not, pilot in 10 stores.
Confirm and surface on product pages.

actions: Confirm the par gaps with the client team
Launch the age and occasion finder

openQuestions: Does the site offer in-store pickup today?
Which search vendor runs site search?
When does the Don Quijote shop-in-shop open?
